name: @valorbrain/connect
description: Wire any CLI agent harness (Claude Code, Kiro, OpenCode, Codex, Grok, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OMP, Hermes) to hosted ValorBrain memory.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "import('./manifest-signature.mjs').then((m) => { if (Object.keys(m.MANIFEST_PUBLIC_KEYS).length === 0) { console.error('MANIFEST_PUBLIC_KEYS is empty: add the production public key to manifest-signature.mjs before publishing (a release that trusts no key refuses every manifest)'); process.exit(1); } })"
